scripts.text:
[Athena Sonotora]
They say the
famous dance school
here in Comodo is going
to open soon.
scripts.translation:
[雅典娜·索諾托拉]
聽說，克魔島那所著名的舞蹈學校就要開學了。

scripts.text:
[Athena Sonotora]
Aah...
To be a prima donna
in the spotlight!
scripts.translation:
[雅典娜·索諾托拉]
啊...
成為聚光燈下的首席舞者！

scripts.text:
[Athena Sonotora]
I want to sign up too,
but the requirements are
so specific. I wonder if
I should just try anyways...
scripts.translation:
[雅典娜·索諾托拉]
我也想報名，可條件定得很細。
要不，還是去試試看...

scripts.text:
[Bor Robin]
Aah....
A prima donna
in the spotlight!
I'll be able to watch them become Dancers right before my eyes...!
scripts.translation:
[博爾·羅賓]
啊...
聚光燈下的首席舞者！
我能親眼看著她們成為舞娘...！

scripts.text:
[Bor Robin]
It's great to be
a man in this day and age! Hurray for the Comodo Theater!
scripts.translation:
[博爾·羅賓]
活在這個時代，做個男人真好！
克魔島劇場萬歲！

scripts.text:
[Bor Robin]
Mm?
You want
to go, too?
It's a good opportunity to watch the Dancer job change test.
scripts.translation:
[博爾·羅賓]
嗯？你也想去？
這可是觀看舞娘轉職考驗的好機會。

scripts.text: Go to the Job Change Area

[Bor Robin]
Huh...
Well, I can't
help it if you don't
want to accompany me.
scripts.translation:
[博爾·羅賓]
唉...
你不想陪我去，那也沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
One two three four,
Two two three four,
three four, three four,
one two three four.
Um?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
一二三四，
二二三四，
三四三四，
一二三四。
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
I'm sorry, but you're interrupting my practice by looking at me funny.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
抱歉，你用那種奇怪的眼神看著我，打擾到我練習了。

[艾爾]
.......
.....嘿，我以前是不是見過你？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Err...
That's weird, I can't remember where I've seen you.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
呃...
奇怪，想不起在哪兒見過你了。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welcome~!
Let me know
if you have any new songs. We can always use some new music to complement our performances.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
歡迎~！
有新歌的話，記得告訴我。
我們的表演，總需要些新音樂來配合。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welcome~!
How are you
these days?
Do many people enjoy
your performances?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
歡迎~！
最近怎麼樣？
喜歡你表演的人多嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welco--Mmm?
Hey, only authorized personnel can come here. Not just anyone can enter the Dance School.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
歡——嗯？
嘿，只有獲准的人才能進來。
舞蹈學校可不是誰都能進的。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
If you want to watch, why don't you go to the Dance Stage in town?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
想看錶演，不如去鎮上的舞臺？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welcome~!
This is the
'Comodo Dance School,'
where we teach various dances from different countries. We provide entertainement for travelers from all over the world.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
歡迎~！
這裡是“克魔島舞蹈學校”，教授各國的舞蹈，也為來自世界各地的旅人帶來歡樂。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
We also provide the opportunity for aspiring Dancers to become famous throughout the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom! Doesn't dancing in the spotlight sound spectacular?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
我們也為胸懷夢想的舞娘提供機會，讓她們名揚盧恩·米德加茲王國！
在聚光燈下起舞，是不是很令人嚮往？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
I think it's fair to let you know that our school is selective. So we don't accept students who don't seem to have the talent to become Dancers.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
得先告訴你，我們招生是有篩選的。
沒有舞蹈天賦的學生，我們可不會收。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
What do you think?
Do you want to sign up? You only have to write a couple of things on the application, and you can just come to the lessons once or twice and try it out.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
怎麼樣，想報名嗎？
申請表只需填幾項，先來上一兩節課，試試看也行。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
So what do
you want to do~?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
那麼，你打算怎麼辦~？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Good choice!!
Just fill out the application right there.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
選得好！
就在那邊填申請表吧。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Your name is
{0}?
Wow! What a pretty name! Just a moment, I have to show this to the director, so come back in a little bit, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
你叫{0}？
哇，名字真好聽！
稍等，我得把申請表給總監看看，過會兒再來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Mmm...
It seems that
you aren't quite qualified to enroll in our school yet. You need to be at least Job Level 40.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
嗯...你還不符合入學條件。
職業等級至少要達到40級。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Well, I hope
that you apply
again when you meet
the requirements.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
希望你符合條件後，再來申請。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Aww~
Just think about it.
Don't forget to come back
if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
哎呀~再考慮一下吧。
改變主意的話，別忘了回來哦。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welco--Mmm?
Hey, this place is only for authorized personnel. If you want to sing, you should go look into being a Bard.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
歡——嗯？
嘿，這裡只有獲准的人才能進來。
想唱歌的話，不如考慮成為詩人。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Not all Archers
can become Dancers.
At least, not without some sort of sex change~
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
可不是所有弓箭手都能成為舞娘。
至少，不變個性是沒辦法的~

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Good.
Since you signed up earlier, I'll let you know some things you'll need to bring for your lessons.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
好，你之前已經報名了。
現在說說，上課需要帶些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
We're short on some supplies, but you'll be using them for yourself anyway. Just think of it as part of the tuition, so don't worry too much.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
我們有些用品不夠，不過，反正都是你自己要用的。
就當學費的一部分，不必太擔心。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, you'll about ^CD688920 Sticky Mucus^000000 for shoe polish.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
首先，學費是^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000。
還需要^CD688920個粘稠液體^000000，用來擦鞋。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Then, bring ^CD68893 Jellopy^000000 and ^CD68895 Red Potions^000000 to use as ointment. And of course, you'll need a pair of ^CD6889Shoes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
再帶^CD68893個傑勒比結晶^000000和^CD68895個紅色藥水^000000，用作藥膏。
當然，還得有一雙^CD6889長靴^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Once again, that's
^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000,
^CD688920 Sticky Mucus^000000,
^CD68893 Jellopy^000000,
^CD68895 Red Potions^000000 and
^CD68891 Shoes^000000.

[Aile]
First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, bring ^CD68895 Earthworm Peelings^000000 for polishing the floor and, of course, a pair of ^CD6889Boots^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
首先，學費是^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000。
再帶^CD68895個蚯蚓皮^000000，用來擦地板。
當然，還需要一雙^CD6889靴子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Once again that's
^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000,
^CD68895 Earthworm Peelings^000000 and 
^CD68891 Boots^000000.

[Aile]
First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, bring ^CD68892 Clam Shells^000000 for your costume, ^CD68895 Yellow Potions^000000 and ^CD688920 Jellopy^000000 to treat foot injuries.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
首先，學費是^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000。
再帶^CD68892個蛤蜊外殼^000000，製作服裝；以及^CD68895個黃色藥水^000000和^CD688920個傑勒比結晶^000000，治療腳傷。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
You'll also need to bring ^CD688910 Black Hairs^000000 to make wigs for the performances and, of course, a pair of ^CD6889Sandals^000000. Once again, that's...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
還需要^CD688910個長髮^000000，製作演出用的假髮。
當然，也得帶一雙^CD6889輕便鞋^000000。
再說一遍，就是...

scripts.text:
[Aile]
^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000,
^CD68892 Clam Shells^000000,
^CD68895 Yellow Potions^000000,
^CD688920 Jellopy^000000,
^CD688910 Black Hairs^000000 and
^CD6889Sandals^000000.

[Aile]
Once you've gathered everything that you need, come back so that we can begin the lessons, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
東西備齊後，就回來開始上課，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Oh...!
You brought
everything!
Alright then,
let me take your
tuition fee.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
哦...！全帶齊了！
好，那我收下學費。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Next, go to ^CD6889Bijou^000000, who is in charge of the interviewing process. She will have a couple of things she'll need to ask you.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
接下來，去找負責面試的^CD6889碧珠^000000。
她有幾個問題要問你。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Mmm...?
You don't have
everything yet?
Let me remind you
so you can bring
what you need next time.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
嗯...？還沒帶齊？
我再提醒一遍，下次記得備齊。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Hmm...?
Are you having
trouble finding
^CD6889Bijou^000000?

[Aile]
You need to talk to her because she's in charge of the interviewing process. Don't worry, she should be somewhere here in the Dance School.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
她負責面試，你得去找她談談。
別擔心，她就在舞蹈學校裡。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
I'll be looking
forward to a great
performance~
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
我期待你的精彩演出~

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welcom--Hm?
Hey, only authorized
personnel are allowed
in here.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
歡——嗯？
嘿，只有獲准的人才能進來。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
If you want to watch, be quiet and don't disturb the performers. Everyone here is busy practicing so that they can become fine Dancers.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾]
想看的話，保持安靜，不要打擾表演者。
大家正忙著練習，努力成為優秀的舞娘。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
You can't change jobs
if you still have skill
points left. Use the rest
and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
技能點沒用完，就不能轉職。
先把剩餘技能點用完，再回來。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Welcome~
Ooh, a Bard! Do you have any new songs to show us? We can always use some musical accompaniment for our dances.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
歡迎~
哦，是詩人！有新歌想唱給我們聽嗎？
我們的舞蹈，總需要些音樂伴奏。

[碧珠]
哎呀...！
歡迎回來~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
How are you
these days?
A lot of people
must love watching
you dance. Are you
enjoying the spotlight?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
你最近過得怎麼樣？
一定有很多人喜歡看你跳舞吧。
享受成為眾人焦點的感覺嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh dear~
You seem to have traveled quite a distance to watch me perform.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀~
看來你為了看我的表演，特地趕了很遠的路呢。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
I'm sorry, but I've retired. Now I'm focusing on training new Dancers. If you go to the Center Stage, you can watch my students~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
抱歉，我已經退休了。
現在專心培養新舞娘。
去中央舞臺就能看到我的學生表演哦~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh my~
You want to
become a Dancer,
don't you?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀~
你想成為舞娘，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
I know you're excited, but the first step is the application. Go over to the left side of the stage where Aile can help you with that.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
我知道你很興奮，不過得先報名。
去舞臺左側找艾爾，她會幫你辦理手續。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh my~
You want to
become a Dancer,
don't you?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀~
你想成為舞娘，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
G-goodness!
Look at that stomach fat!
Well, it's not much, so you'll lose it in no time. Especially since I'll be handling your training~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
天、天哪！
看看你肚子上的贅肉！
不過也不多，很快就能減掉的。
何況還有我親自指導你訓練呢~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Still...
The idea of the
perfect body sure
has changed since
I was young. Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
不過...
如今人們心目中的完美身材，跟我年輕時可真不一樣了。
總之...

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Let's start
with the interview.
I'm only going to ask
a couple of simple things
so don't worry~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
先從面試開始吧。
我只會問幾個簡單的問題，別擔心~

[碧珠]
好的...
我們開始吧。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh, you're back~
Have you studied
some more? Try to
pass this time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哦，你回來了~
又好好複習過了嗎？
這次爭取通過，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
1. The Dancer's dance, ^CD6889Lady Luck^000000,
increases which of the following?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
1. 舞娘的技能^CD6889女神之吻^000000能提升以下哪項屬性？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
2. Of the following,
which can you not consider
to be a dance?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
2. 以下哪一項不屬於舞蹈？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
3. Which of the following
best describes a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
3. 以下哪項最能描述舞娘？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
4. Which of the following
cannot be associated with Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
4. 以下哪項與克魔島無關？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
5. Before Comodo, what is the region name of the region NorthEast of Pharoah's Lighthouse Island?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
5. 在到達克魔島之前，法老燈塔島東北方向的地區叫什麼？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
6. Who is the most
beautiful dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
6. 誰是最美麗的舞娘？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
...
That's...
^660000completely wrong^000000.
Didn't you see the
other choices?!
Minus points...!

[Bijou]
7. Of the following,
who can perform together
with a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
7. 以下誰可以和舞娘一起表演？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
8. Which of the following
is not a specialty of Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
8. 以下哪項不是克魔島的特色？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
9. Who is the manager
of the Comodo Casino?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
9. 誰是克魔島賭場的管理員？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
10. Who accepts the
Dancer job change
applications?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
10. 誰負責受理舞娘的轉職申請？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
1. What is the effect
of the combined skill,
^CD6889Mental Sensing^000000?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
1. 合奏技能^CD6889經驗值倍增^000000有什麼效果？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
2. Which is considered
bad etiquette on the dance
floor after a dance?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
2. 跳完舞后，在舞池裡做什麼會顯得不禮貌？

scripts.text: Ask to dance a different dance.

[Bijou]
3. Which is not an
appropriate response
when someone makes
a mistake while you
are dancing together?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
3. 一起跳舞時，如果對方出錯了，以下哪種反應不恰當？

scripts.text: Smile at each other and continue dancing.
Ignore it if the dancer does not realize it.
scripts.translation: 對方沒察覺就當作沒發生

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
4. In which town
can you change jobs
to a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
4. 在哪個城鎮可以轉職為舞娘？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
5. How many dungeons
are directly connected
to Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
5. 有多少個地下城與克魔島直接相連？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
6. Which of the following
is not a Cute Pet monster?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
6. 以下哪種魔物不能成為寵物？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
7. Who is the most
graceful dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
7. 誰是最優雅的舞娘？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
...
That's...
^660000completely wrong^000000.
Didn't you see the
other choices?!
Minus points...!

[Bijou]
8. What is the
exact name of the
Kafra in Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
8. 克魔島的卡普拉職員全名是什麼？

scripts.text: Casts the Blind effect in the area.
Casts the Sleep effect on the area.
Puts a night effect on the area.

[Bijou]
1. What is the effect
of the skill ^CD6889Dance Lessons^000000?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
1. 技能^CD6889練習舞蹈^000000的效果是什麼？

scripts.text: Increases the effect of dancing skills
Inflict Stun on a certain area around the caster.
scripts.translation: 使施法者周圍一定範圍內的目標眩暈

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
2. What dance uses shoes
that are designed to make
sound as the dancer rolls
their feet and taps the
ground to create a rhythm?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
2. 哪種舞蹈穿著特製的鞋子，通過腳部的轉動和踏地發出聲音，打出節奏？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
3. Which of the following
is not a characteristic of a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
3. 以下哪項不是舞娘的特徵？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
4. Which town has
the most Dancers?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
4. 哪個城鎮的舞娘最多？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
5. Of the following,
who dances most beautifully?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
5. 以下誰跳舞最優美？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
...
That's...
^660000completely wrong^000000.
Didn't you see the
other choices?!
Minus points...!

[Bijou]
6. What is the Dancer
better at than the other
job classes?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
6. 與其他職業相比，舞娘更擅長什麼？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
7. Who is the manager
of the Comodo Casino?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
7. 克魔島賭場的管理員是誰？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
8. What item cannot
be equipped by a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
8. 舞娘無法裝備以下哪件物品？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
9. Do you think you
can say this quiz is
frustrating and annoying?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
9. 你覺得可以說這場測驗讓人煩躁、討厭嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
10. Which of the following
is not a Jazz musician?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
10. 以下哪位不是爵士樂音樂家？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Good job~
It seems like you
answered all the
questions~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
做得好~
看來你已經答完所有問題了~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Let's see...
Your score is
{0} points...
Very well done!
A perfect score!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
讓我看看...
你的得分是 {0} 分...
非常棒！
滿分！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Let's see...
Your score is
{0} points...
It wasn't perfect, but I'll let you pass.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
讓我看看...
你的得分是 {0} 分...
雖然沒拿到滿分，不過還是讓你通過吧。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Let's see...
Your score is
{0} points...
You.. You failed!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
讓我看看...
你的得分是 {0} 分...
你...你沒通過！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
There aren't too many people who apply for the Dancer job with this kind of knowledge. I'm sorry for judging you by your looks~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
來報名轉職舞娘的人，像你這樣知識豐富的可不多。
抱歉，剛才以貌取人了~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Whew~
Now you only have the Dance Test. While we prepare the test, why don't you rest a bit? Ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
呼~
現在只剩舞蹈測試了。
趁我們準備測試，你先休息一下吧？
Ho ho ho~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Was it too hard?
When I was young, everyone knew at least enough to pass this test. Go and study some more before coming back, okay?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
太難了嗎？
我年輕的時候，這些都是人人都懂的知識，足夠通過測試了。
回去再好好學習一下再來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Okay...
Are you ready
for the Dance Test?
If you like, I can
explain the instructions.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
好...
準備好參加舞蹈測試了嗎？
需要的話，我可以先講講規則。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
First of all, each person gets ^CD68891 minute^000000 for the test, and everyone dances ^CD6889one at a time^000000. Don't worry if you've never danced before~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
首先，每個人的測試時間是^CD68891分鐘^000000，而且^CD6889每次只考一人^000000。
就算以前沒跳過舞，也不用擔心~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Once you enter the testing area, you will see the stage. First, ^CD6889change your camera angle so that it faces forward^000000. It will probably work if you ^CD6889double-click on the right mouse button^000000.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
進入測試區域後，你會看到舞臺。
首先，^CD6889調整視角，讓鏡頭朝向正前方^000000。
一般^CD6889雙擊滑鼠右鍵^000000就可以了。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
If you don't reset your camera angle, you may get the ^CD6889Up, Down, Left, Right^000000 commands confused.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
如果不重置視角，你可能會搞混^CD6889上、下、左、右^000000的指令。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Wait for your turn in the ^CD6889waiting room^000000. If the person in front of you fails, or if it's your turn in line, your test will begin.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
請在^CD6889候考室^000000等候。
前面的人測試失敗，或是排到你時，你的測試就會開始。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
If there are a lot of people, not everyone might fit in the waiting room. If that's the case, just create an orderly line~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
人多的話，候考室可能容不下所有人。
這時請大家有序排隊~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
When the test begins, the music will be broadcast, as well as the direction in which you should move. Just follow the instructions and move your legs.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
測試開始後，會播放音樂，同時告訴你該往哪個方向移動。
跟著指令邁步就行了。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Remember, ^CD6889you will be disqualified if you don't perform the steps with the right timing^000000. Be careful, the test is very strict~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
記住，^CD6889如果沒有在正確的時機邁出舞步，就會被取消資格^000000。
要小心，測試的判定很嚴格哦~

[碧珠]
那麼~
祝你好運...!!

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh my...
Did you
fail last time?
Don't worry, just
try to feel the rhythm~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀...
上次沒通過嗎？
別擔心，試著感受節奏吧~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
You can't change jobs
if you still have skill
points left. Use the rest
and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
還有未分配的技能點就不能轉職。
先把剩餘的技能點用完再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh my...
I saw your
dance earlier.
You were great!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀...
剛才我看了你的舞蹈。
跳得真棒！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Your performance shows that you are than qualified to become a Dancer. Well then, let me change your job.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
你的表現證明，你完全有資格成為舞娘。
那麼，我來為你轉職吧。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
With the blessing of our goddess, you shall be reborn as a Dancer. From now on, no one will leave your presense without a smile~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
在女神的祝福下，你將以舞娘的身份迎來新生。
從今往後，所有人都會帶著笑容離開你的身邊~

scripts.text:
Ooh...!
You look great
as a Dancer~
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
Ooh...!
你成為舞娘的樣子真美~
恭喜！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Here's a small
gift from me.
Please take it.
May your performances always bring joy to your audience~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
這是我送你的一份小禮物。
請收下。
願你的表演總能為觀眾帶來歡樂~

scripts.text:
[Pyorgin]
Please wait in
the waiting room.
Click the Chatroom
box to enter.
scripts.translation:
[皮奧爾金]
請在候考室等候。
點選聊天室視窗即可進入。

scripts.text:
[Pyorgin]
Also, those who
are curious about
the test can watch
backstage.
scripts.translation:
[皮奧爾金]
另外，想了解測試的人也可以在後臺觀看。
